# **How Swipe Helped Murthy & Kanth Modernise Their CA Practice**


**Pradyumna Teja K. from Murthy & Kanth** shares how Swipe helped the chartered accountancy practice simplify billing, automate routine accounting tasks, streamline GST workflows, and become more efficient in its day-to-day operations.


Murthy & Kanth is a chartered accountancy practice established in 1984. Over the years, the firm has witnessed major changes in finance, taxation, compliance, and the way accounting practices operate.


As these processes became increasingly digital, the team realised that relying heavily on manual workflows was no longer practical. Automation had become an important part of running a modern and efficient CA practice.


## **Why Murthy & Kanth chose automation**


For accountants managing client records, billing, GST returns, tax documents, and their daily accounting work, even small and repetitive jobs require a lot of time.


Murthy & Kanth needed a digital billing solution that would reduce the paperwork and thus make billing simpler.


While looking for a proper solution, the team discovered Swipe.


After using the software for some months regularly, Swipe became one of the software products that are really helpful for the work of the accountants.


## **What Murthy & Kanth liked about Swipe**


In a certified accounting company, some of the major issues are time management, precision maintenance, client information management, and the interconnecting of various accounting processes.


Based on Pradyumna Teja K.'s opinion, Swipe has helped the company overcome those problems in many ways.


- The implementation of automation of time-consuming tasks led to saving time on processes previously conducted manually.
- Through GST return-related integration, handling GST-based tasks was made easy.
- The comprehensive platform made it possible to perform tasks related to billing, keeping the database of clients, and GST processing from a single entry point.
- Due to the simple and user-friendly interface, the employees quickly started to use the system efficiently.


According to Murthy & Kanth, Swipe has proved to be much more than just an accounting program for them since, due to the breakthrough auto-billing and GST functions, it turned out to be convenient for daily accounting operations.


## **How Swipe improved the firm's workflow**


Accounting software should make daily work easier rather than add another layer of complexity.


That was one of the key reasons Swipe worked well for Murthy & Kanth.


By bringing billing, client information, GST workflows, and other routine activities onto a single platform, the firm was able to reduce dependence on scattered processes and manual tracking.


Automation also helped minimise repetitive work and reduce the chances of human errors.


More importantly, the time saved on routine accounting activities gave the team more room to focus on client servicing and other important areas of the practice.


## **Why the firm continues to trust Swipe**


Reliability and user-friendliness are crucial elements in the selection of a billing and accounting software for CA firms.


According to Murthy & Kanth, Swipe was found to have a simple user interface that does not complicate the regular accounting procedures excessively.


The application enabled the firm to do the billing, automate some accounting tasks, and manage GST processes and client details easily.


Adopting Swipe showed that even an established practice can make use of technology without giving up existing processes altogether.


## **A message for fellow CAs and business owners**


A crucial takeaway from the situation of Murthy & Kanth is that firms should not postpone their automation and only switch to automated systems once they are overwhelmed by inefficient manual processes.


In the words of Pradyumna Teja K.:


“Do not delay. Automate. A computer program like Swipe does not simply help save time. It changes the entire nature of your enterprise into a more effective and lively entity.”


Regardless if it is an established CA firm or a newly launched business, manual invoicing and disintegrated accounting processes will always slow down productivity over time.


The use of a digital billing solution allows firms to benefit from the reduced amount of redundant work and improved organisation of their operations.


## **Final thoughts**


Murthy and Kanth’s experience with Swipe shows how even an accounting firm that has existed for several decades can gain tremendously from new billing technology.


Through automating billing, simplifying GST processes, and combining various accounting processes on one platform, the company was able to streamline its daily operations.


For firms that still rely on manual invoices, switch between multiple applications, or spend hours correcting everyday billing mistakes, moving to automation can be transformative.
